letterContent: The clock strikes midnight, and every ghoul is out searching for treats...
Yet out of all the shadows in this haunted world, my eyes are bewitched only by you.
Will you join me on a midnight adventure under the blood moon tonight?

scratchCard.title: ✦ BREAK THE MIDNIGHT CURSE ✦
scratchCard.hiddenText: Spell Unlocked: 1x Midnight Movie Marathon + All The Candy You Want! 🎃

runawayQuestion.question: Will you let me haunt your heart forever?
runawayQuestion.successMessage: Curse bound! You are officially mine this Spooky Season! 🦇🎃
